description: Charge a method the payer already saved, for one invoice. Only where autopay is on — otherwise send a payment link. Idempotent per invoice, amount and method, so a retry cannot charge twice.

invoice_id.description: The invoice to collect. Must be issued, overdue or partly paid.

provider.description: Only if the firm has several processors and this should not use their default.

payment_method_id.description: Which saved method to charge. Omit for the one the payer is billed to; pass one from manage_saved_cards to try another after a decline.
